title: Ammunition depot in Massachusetts
summary: After leave they made shells at a depot for about eighteen months; he was seaman first class.

blocks.x: Yeah, see, after we graduated from boot training, then we had leave, we came home for nine days, and went back and we were shipped to Massachusetts. And that's when we found out. Well, what we were doing then, we worked at an ammunition depot, making shells for ships, for airplanes and things, making all kinds of shells, even to the big 16-H. And I stayed there about 18 months. And then, now this is where we made history. So that was your duty?
Yeah. What was your rank, and what were you trained for?
Oh, well, I was seamen first class. You know, really we were sailors, but we were like, more or less like Seabees.
